name: OSI Greater Philadelphia Land Protection Program: Neighborhood Conservation Grants
summary: Small grants for planning, partnership building and early-stage work toward permanent land protection in Philadelphia and Camden, for community organisations, land trusts and other nonprofits. Priorities include habitat, parks and trails, local food systems and nature-based climate solutions.

fiscal_sponsor.note: The sponsor is a tax-exempt nonprofit

eligibility.rule: Applicant is tax-exempt or uses a tax-exempt nonprofit fiscal sponsor
Project contributes to a broader vision for community-centered land protection
Single-site projects have wider community impact or serve as a replicable model
No land acquisition or stewardship implementation activities
No political activity or state/federal legislative or administrative lobbying

documents: Completed Neighborhood Conservation Grant Budget Form

status.quote: We are happy to announce the Neighborhood Conservation Grants opportunity is now available.

deadline.quote: Application Deadline: 11:59pm EST on Monday, February 15, 2027.

applicant_types.quote: OSI invites applications from land trusts, nonprofit organizations, and Philadelphia or Camden City municipal agency partners committed to advancing permanent land protection in those cities.

geography.quote: the GPLPP includes a dedicated neighborhood conservation strategy for Philadelphia and Camden

access.quote: We are happy to announce the Neighborhood Conservation Grants opportunity is now available.

window.quote: A second round is planned for early 2028.

amount.quote: Applicants may request up to $40,000 in grant support.

pool.quote: $240,000 is expected to be available in this round.

fiscal_sponsor.quote: The applicant must be a tax-exempt non-profit organization. If applying through a fiscal sponsor, the sponsor must be a tax-exempt nonprofit organization.

effort.quote: Applications are due by 11:59pm on Monday, February 15, 2027 and must be submitted through OSI's grant management system, Foundant (see Next Steps to Apply, below).

eligibility.quote: The applicant must be a tax-exempt non-profit organization. If applying through a fiscal sponsor, the sponsor must be a tax-exempt nonprofit organization.
proposed projects must contribute to a broader vision for community-centered land protection
Projects focused on a single site/parcel that do not have wider community impact or serve as a replicable model
These funds cannot be used for land acquisition or stewardship implementation activities.
Any political activity, or legislative or administrative lobbying at state or federal level

after_award.quote: During the grant term, grantees can expect to complete a mid-year check-in or submit a progress report. At the end of the grant term, grantees will submit a final report detailing work completed, impact, and potential next steps.

documents.quote: Budget Form* Please download the "Neighborhood Conservation Grant Budget Form" linked on the Greater Philadelphia Land Protection Program webpage, complete it, and upload it here.
